**Verdict: FAIL** for DG0 candidate `ef3ec3f2…` (commit `a23c4d4`). The D-036 repair itself is correct. The failure is that DG0 can never be approved on this repository's real history, however round 20 ends.

HEAD is `ce6d9b6`, a freeze commit that changes only delivery records after `a23c4d4`, and the recomputed candidate ID matches. I read no other round-20 review record.

**Checks that passed**
- **Required commands:** all exit 0, run in a throwaway clone. That covers source extraction, the gate tests (55/55), the agent tests (39/39), and `--register DG0`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile` and `candidate.mjs`.
- **`prefreeze.sh DG0` in a fresh clone:** 11/11 passed.
- **My own negative tests (A24/A25):** the earlier 94-case suite gives the expected results. I added 12 new cases for D-036 that aren't in `tools/gates/tests/`; all pass.
- **Non-gate rounds:** a round whose commit was pruned is still accepted, as D-035 intends.
- **Metadata:** review and gate records don't change the candidate ID; an edit to the validator does.
- **D-036 on a copy of the real repository:** a drafted gate pointing at a non-existent commit is rejected in current mode. The control with the real commit is not.
- **The new unit test:** it fails against the old validator and passes on the candidate, so it really guards the fix.
- **Register integrity:** 0 errors across 412 rows, with no VERIFIED rows, full A01–A28 coverage and both coverage matrices complete.
- **Agent setup:** 10 load runs with 10 distinct sessions, all on `claude-opus-5-5`, every out-of-scope write blocked. `docs/delivery/agents.md` matches the raw run records exactly.
- **Live guard:** my own write to `docs/source/QA-PROBE.txt` was blocked by the write guard (Write tool) and by the read-only filesystem (shell).
- **Feasibility:** all 28 scenarios have a test level, a first stage and a gate.

**My earlier finding:** F-DG0-240 is verified fixed and recorded as CLOSED_VERIFIED.

**New findings** (all owned by `delivery-orchestrator`; none is a mandatory violation, because the validator refuses rather than wrongly approves):

| ID | Severity | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| F-DG0-242 | **High** | I drafted an APPROVED gate on the real frozen commit and ran the validator. It reports 195 errors that finishing round 20 can't clear. They come from commits deleted when history was cut before round 12 and rewritten in D-034. 66 closed findings point at fix commits that no longer exist (132 errors). The reviewer runs behind 63 verifications started from commits that no longer exist (63 errors). D-035 only allowed for deleted commits in one place (`findManifest`); two other checks still reject them. |
| F-DG0-243 | **High** | D-034 kept the round-17 and round-18 qa-verifier sidecars that have no review record, but the validator rejects them (2 errors). It also reports F-DG0-238 as "dropped" from `findings.json`. Write-once rules mean these files can never be removed, so the gate stays blocked. |
| F-DG0-244 | Medium | Two gaps in delivery records, fixable without changing the candidate. No reviewer's round-19 evidence was ever committed, so 6 verification-evidence references don't exist in any clone. `fix_revision` is missing on F-DG0-232 and abbreviated (short hash) on 152/153/239, and on the pending 154/155/156/240. |
| F-DG0-241 | Low | D-036 only checks that the gate's commit exists. A commit with identical content but not on the branch passes locally, then fails in any fresh clone (CI). I'd accept this as an observation. |

**Two things I couldn't do**
- **Clean-up:** a safety check refused my first `rm -rf` because it used `$TMPDIR` globs. I re-ran it with literal paths and the three clones are gone. Small `.log` scratch files remain in the run's private temp directory, which the runner deletes when the run ends.
- **Evidence commit:** my round-20 evidence and new test scripts are on disk but untracked. The runner's auto-commit only picks up review records and run files, so the orchestrator needs to commit this evidence. Otherwise it goes the way of the round-19 evidence (F-DG0-244).

The auto mode classifier refused one harness design that ran code taken from an environment variable. I replaced it with a fixed list of named test variants, so it cost no coverage.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG0/round-20/qa-verifier.json
- reviews/DG0/round-20/qa-verifier.findings.json
- reviews/DG0/round-20/qa-verifier.verifications.json
- test-evidence/DG0/qa/round-20/ (logs)
- test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/ (dg0-gate-negative-r20.test.mjs, real-repo-d036.mjs, real-repo-gate-blockers.mjs)
